flash_startup_repair.fix_1_codestart: assemble device/source/2803x_CodeStartBranch.asm -> 2803x_CodeStartBranch.obj, added to both FLASH links; asm standardized to `.global code_start; .sect "codestart"; code_start: LB _c_int00`
flash_startup_repair.fix_3_flash_build_macro: -DSTAGE6_FLASH_BUILD=1 added to every C compile command in both FLASH builds (normal sources + soft_start.c special compile); RAM build unchanged (macro not defined)

on_target_full_test_blocker.observation: ITRAP_OR_ROM_TRAP_OBSERVED: under continuous (no-breakpoint) main/APP_Init execution the CPU vectors to 0x3FF8CD (illegal-instruction trap in boot ROM). Non-deterministic: sometimes System_Init PLL-lock wait is the stall point, sometimes an immediate ITRAP to 0x3FF8CD. PLL itself locks (PLLLOCKS=1, PLLSTS.all=385 read via expression).
